title: SASC Open Hearing Case 19Nov2024
doc_notes: This document is an AARO report presented to the Senate Armed Services Subcommittee on Emerging Threats and Capabilities detailing the resolution of three specific UAP cases.

incidents.summary: USCBP aircraft recorded IR video of an object over Puerto Rico that appeared to split and enter/exit water.
incidents.explanation: The object was two distinct objects traveling at wind speed; the splitting and water entry were illusions caused by sensor angle and motion parallax.
incidents.quote: The video appears to show an object traveling at high speed, splitting into two objects, and entering and exiting the water.

incidents.summary: US Navy aircraft recorded an object appearing to travel at high speeds close to the ocean surface.
incidents.explanation: The object was at 13,000 feet traveling at 45 mph, with the appearance of high speed attributed to wind and aircraft movement.
incidents.quote: In January 2015, U.S. Navy aircraft recorded an object appearing to travel at high speeds close to the ocean surface

incidents.summary: UAV observed an object passing through the Mt. Etna volcanic plume.
incidents.explanation: The object was a balloon drifting with the wind, not passing through the plume.
incidents.quote: capturing video of a potential UAP seemingly passing through the volcano's plume
